## General Summary
The document is a report of the Local Housing Board of the City of Malolos concerning **Proposed City Ordinance No. 04-2026**. The ordinance amends an earlier City Ordinance (No. 13‑46‑2022) to formally establish the Local Housing Board, define its composition (including the Vice Mayor as chairperson and representatives from the Presidential Commission for the Urban Poor, accredited People’s Organizations, and NGOs), and set out its powers and functions—most notably the monitoring and regulation of evictions and demolitions, the requirement for a compliance checklist and certificate, and the issuance of an Eviction and Demolition Compliance Certificate. The board, chaired by Vice Mayor Luis Alfonso M. Arcega, discussed the proposal, reached consensus among its members, and recommended its approval and acceptance of the board’s report.

### Pages 1-3
Pages 1‑3 present the complete report of the Local Housing Board meeting. **Page 1** introduces the proposed ordinance, its purpose, and the initial points outlining the board’s authority, the legal basis (Memorandum Circular No. 2008‑14), and the need for additional amendments. **Page 2** details the board’s composition—adding representatives from the Presidential Commission for the Urban Poor, accredited People’s Organizations, and SEC‑registered NGOs—and enumerates the new powers and functions, such as monitoring evictions, requiring a compliance checklist and certificate, and issuing the Eviction and Demolition Compliance Certificate. **Page 3** records the members’ opinions, the agreement to support the ordinance at the board level, and the formal action and recommendation to approve the ordinance and accept the board’s report, naming the chairperson (Vice Mayor Luis Alfonso M. Arcega) and the participating members.
